productcert_csaf.notes: P354: council class 'open' (all three P354 feeds open); synced out of band into the local CSAF index; documents only from cert-portal.siemens.com (https), <= 2,000 per sync, <= 5 MB each, ROLIE rel=hash .sha512 checked. Reports show excerpts plus links only.
